body.name: Fixed one-alias-block legal-lift stratification handle
body.construction: Restrict to \(\mathcal S^{+}_{2+1}\), fix \((g,r)=(0,1)\), and use \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{lift}}\) as follows. Form the similarity-invariant projector onto the emission-distinct state and its complementary two-state alias block from rational fixed-chart stopped-law coordinates. Parameterize the legal similarity centralizer on that two-state block, clear only denominators certified nonzero on the positive interior stratum, and reduce constancy of each coordinate of \(\pi^0_{0,1}\) to branchwise univariate numerator tests. Use subresultant chains and Sturm--Habicht sign determination to enumerate all positive legal-fiber components, separating the HDK branch from each forecast-degenerate numerator branch on which HDK fails but \(\pi^0_{0,1}\) is constant. Record every resulting polynomial or rational invariant and its degree; exploit the fixed one-block dimension rather than generic cylindrical algebraic decomposition.
inputs: rational coordinates of \(P_W\in\mathcal S^{+}_{2+1}\) in the predeclared chart
